articleBodyHtml:
Introduction to the Birthday Celebration

The group is discussing playing a game, specifically Twister, and considering how to manage playing with five people. It is mentioned that it might be tricky for all five of them to play at once, and a suggestion is made to play one at a time to make it fun.

A special rule for the game Posing Twister is introduced, which involves striking poses while playing Twister. This rule is suggested as a fun addition to the game.

relatedStreams.title: Nerissa Ravencroft、『AGREE』の「同意」地獄に挑戦　2時間で10/12まで進む
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: Nerissa Ravencroftが、FUWAMOCOとBibooに勧められたゲーム『AGREE』に挑戦した。配信後にダンスレッスンを控え、使える時間は約2時間。ゲームを始めるための「同意」は一度押せば終わりではなく、パズルや計算、料理、認証コード入力などへ次々と姿を変えてNerissaを足止めする。最後まで「Doki Doki Action Game」にたどり着けないまま、それでも12段階中10まで進めて配信を終えた。
